title: Base Table with many Occurrences
description: Code-style rule — base tables with more than eight table occurrences. A very high occurrence count signals a tangled relationship graph.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: Dozens of occurrences per table make the relationship graph hard to reason about.
rule.remediation: Consolidate occurrences; adopt an anchor-buoy or selector-connector pattern.
